label: 가장 뻔뻔한 상인에게 상을 준다
label_en: Give the award to the most shameless vendor
success_text_en: The vendors cheer and fill your offering box.

label: 정가를 지킨 상인을 몰래 칭찬한다
label_en: Quietly praise the vendor who kept fair prices
success_text: 정직한 상인이 눈물을 글썽이며 고개를 숙입니다.
success_text_en: The honest vendor bows, eyes glistening.
fail_text_en: Someone overhears and spreads rumors of a 'hypocrite cult leader.'

label: 상패를 경매에 부친다
label_en: Auction off the plaque itself
success_text: 상인들끼리 값을 올리다 큰 돈이 모입니다.
success_text_en: The vendors bid each other up and a fortune piles in.
fail_text: 경매가 싸움판이 되어 시장이 엉망이 됩니다.
fail_text_en: The auction turns into a brawl and the market is wrecked.

label: 가장 큰 꿈을 말한 학생을 뽑는다
label_en: Pick the student with the biggest dream
success_text_en: Impressed parents start coming to your gatherings.

label: '나눠 먹겠다'고 한 아이를 뽑는다
label_en: Pick the child who said 'I'll share'
success_text_en: The child beams, but the parents mutter.
fail_text_en: The PTA brands you 'a corrupter of children.'

label: 모든 아이에게 사탕을 잔뜩 준다
label_en: Shower every child with candy
success_text_en: The children follow you everywhere.
fail_text: 배탈 난 아이들 때문에 항의가 들어옵니다.
fail_text_en: Complaints pour in over children with stomachaches.

label: 두둑하게 찔러준다
label_en: Slip him a fat envelope
success_text: 공무원이 허가서에 도장을 쾅 찍어 줍니다.
success_text_en: The official stamps your permit with a flourish.

label: 정중히 거절한다
label_en: Politely refuse
success_text_en: Flustered, the official backs off, calling you 'an odd one.'
fail_text: 교단 건물에 갑자기 위생 점검이 몰려옵니다.
fail_text_en: Sudden health inspections swarm your buildings.

label: 더 큰 뇌물로 그의 상관을 산다
label_en: Buy his superior with a bigger bribe
success_text: 상관이 당신 편이 되어 공무원이 쩔쩔맵니다.
success_text_en: The superior sides with you and the official squirms.
fail_text_en: The superior pockets the money and ignores you.

label: 둘 다 더 사치하라고 부추긴다
label_en: Egg them both on to splurge more
success_text: 골목이 축제처럼 들썩이고 당신 이름이 오르내립니다.
success_text_en: The alley erupts like a festival and your name is on every lip.

label: 검소한 쪽의 손을 들어준다
label_en: Side with the frugal one
success_text: 검소한 쪽이 고맙다며 조용히 차를 대접합니다.
success_text_en: The frugal one quietly serves you tea in thanks.
fail_text_en: The crowd boos and disperses.

label: 판정 대가로 둘 다에게 헌금을 받는다
label_en: Charge both of them for the ruling
success_text_en: Both happily open their wallets.
fail_text_en: People accuse you of selling the verdict.

label: 저자에게 맞장구치며 교리에 녹인다
label_en: Agree and weave it into doctrine
success_text: 대담 내용이 그대로 교리집 한 장이 됩니다.
success_text_en: The talk becomes a chapter of your scriptures.

label: 절제를 옹호하며 반박한다
label_en: Defend temperance and rebut
success_text: 의외의 논리에 청중 일부가 깊이 고개를 끄덕입니다.
success_text_en: Your unexpected logic makes some listeners nod deeply.
fail_text: 청중이 웃음을 터뜨리고 당신은 망신을 당합니다.
fail_text_en: The audience bursts out laughing and you are humiliated.

label: 책 판매 수익 분배를 협상한다
label_en: Negotiate a share of book profits
success_text: 저자가 교단 이름을 표지에 넣어 줍니다.
success_text_en: The author puts your cult's name on the cover.
fail_text_en: The author cancels, saying you only talk money.

label: 성대한 만찬을 연다
label_en: Throw a lavish feast
success_text_en: Everyone pats their bellies, bonding like family.

label: 직접 대식 대결에 나선다
label_en: Compete in the eating contest yourself
success_text_en: Your appetite earns a standing ovation.
fail_text_en: You collapse from overeating and are carried off.

label: 소박한 식사를 나누자고 한다
label_en: Suggest a simple shared meal
success_text_en: It becomes a quiet but warm meal.
fail_text_en: Some grumble about a 'stingy leader.'

label: 구호에 맞춰 함께 외친다
label_en: Chant along with them
success_text_en: The more you shout, the more strangely certain you feel.

label: 창문을 닫고 기도를 이어간다
label_en: Close the window and keep praying
success_text_en: Beyond the noise, a quiet certainty arrives.
fail_text_en: The chant won't leave your head.

label: 밖에 나가 구호의 의미를 묻는다
label_en: Go out and ask what the chant means
success_text_en: Talking with the marchers gives you new inspiration.
fail_text_en: They mock you as 'an old prayer-mumbler.'

label: 이웃을 속여 이기는 법을 가르친다
label_en: Teach them how to outwit the neighbors
success_text_en: The follower leaves triumphant.

label: 정직함은 부끄럽지 않다고 위로한다
label_en: Comfort them: honesty is nothing to be ashamed of
success_text_en: The follower dries their tears and steadies themselves.
fail_text_en: 'Even you are naive,' they sigh, disappointed.

label: 이웃들을 교단 잔치에 초대한다
label_en: Invite the neighbors to a cult banquet
success_text: 잔치가 끝나자 이웃들이 신도를 다르게 봅니다.
success_text_en: After the feast, the neighbors see the follower differently.
fail_text_en: The neighbors eat their fill and mock even harder.

label: 파티 주례를 맡는다
label_en: Officiate the party
success_text_en: Relatives sign up with your cult one by one.

label: 할머니의 절약을 기리는 추도사를 한다
label_en: Give a eulogy honoring Grandma's thrift
success_text: 몇몇 노인들이 조용히 당신 손을 잡습니다.
success_text_en: A few elders quietly take your hand.
fail_text_en: The family is furious you ruined the mood.

label: 유산 일부를 헌금으로 권한다
label_en: Suggest donating part of the inheritance
success_text_en: The family makes a generous offering.
fail_text_en: You are accused of profiting off the dead.

label: 불 대신 헌금함에 넣으라고 설득한다
label_en: Convince him to put it in the offering box instead
success_text_en: The young man laughs and hands over the bundles.
fail_text_en: Calling you petty, he burns it all anyway.

label: 함께 지폐를 태우며 연설한다
label_en: Burn bills alongside him and give a speech
success_text: 타오르는 불꽃 속에 당신의 연설이 화제가 됩니다.
success_text_en: Your speech amid the flames becomes the talk of the town.

label: 가난한 이웃에게 나누자고 한다
label_en: Suggest giving it to poor neighbors
success_text_en: Several families make it through the winter.
fail_text_en: You're mocked for 'outdated charity.'

label: 열정적인 질투를 축복한다
label_en: Bless their passionate jealousy
success_text_en: The couple gazes at each other more fiercely.

label: 서로 믿는 법을 가르친다
label_en: Teach them to trust each other
success_text_en: The couple holds hands and smiles.
fail_text_en: Contestants leave, calling you boring.

label: 모든 신도 부부를 모아 축제로 키운다
label_en: Gather every couple and make it a festival
success_text_en: The festival becomes a tight-knit community event.
fail_text_en: The jealousy erupts into real fights.

label: 부모의 돈을 마음껏 쓰라고 한다
label_en: Tell them to spend their parents' money freely
success_text_en: The youth leaves looking relieved.

label: 부모의 희생에 감사하라고 한다
label_en: Tell them to be grateful for the sacrifice
success_text: 청년이 그날 밤 부모에게 전화를 겁니다.
success_text_en: That night, the youth calls their parents.
fail_text_en: The youth turns away, calling you old-fashioned.

label: 부모까지 교단에 데려오라고 한다
label_en: Tell them to bring the parents to the cult
success_text_en: The whole family attends services together.
fail_text_en: The parents drag their child away from 'that weird place.'

label: 화려하게 출연한다
label_en: Appear in full splendor
success_text: 방송 후 길거리에서 사인 요청이 쏟아집니다.
success_text_en: After the broadcast, autograph requests pour in on the street.

label: 재산을 부풀려 우승을 노린다
label_en: Inflate your wealth to win
success_text_en: You're crowned 'Greediest of the Year.'
fail_text_en: The lie is exposed and you're mocked as a pauper pretending to be rich.

label: 출연을 거절한다
label_en: Decline the appearance
success_text_en: The station briefly calls it 'false modesty.'

label: 안건을 지지하고 의장직을 맡는다
label_en: Back the motion and take the chair
success_text_en: The residents elect you block leader.

label: 안건에 반대 연설을 한다
label_en: Speak against the motion
success_text: 의외로 많은 주민이 당신 편에 섭니다.
success_text_en: Surprisingly many residents stand with you.
fail_text_en: You get nicknamed 'the do-gooder addict.'

label: 벌금을 교단이 걷기로 한다
label_en: Arrange for the cult to collect the fines
success_text_en: Your cult becomes the neighborhood treasury.
fail_text_en: Residents protest, calling you tax thieves.

label: '욕망 술래잡기'를 가르친다
label_en: Teach them 'Desire Tag'
success_text: 새 놀이가 동네 아이들 사이에 퍼집니다.
success_text_en: The new game spreads among the local kids.

label: 놀림받는 아이 편을 들어준다
label_en: Stand up for the teased child
success_text_en: The child clings to your sleeve.
fail_text_en: The kids start calling you 'Teetotaler Leader.'

label: 놀이 규칙을 교리 우화로 만든다
label_en: Turn the game rules into a doctrinal parable
success_text: 우화가 설교 시간에 큰 호응을 얻습니다.
success_text_en: The parable is a hit during sermons.
fail_text_en: Adults sneer at doctrine built from child's play.

label: 변한 게 성공이라고 자랑한다
label_en: Boast that changing is success
success_text_en: Your friend looks at you with envy.

label: 옛 시절을 함께 회상한다
label_en: Reminisce together about the old days
success_text_en: Your long-forgotten original resolve revives.
fail_text: 그 시절이 다시는 오지 않음에 쓸쓸해집니다.
fail_text_en: You grow lonely knowing those days won't return.

label: 친구를 신도로 포섭한다
label_en: Recruit your friend as a follower
success_text: 친구가 웃으며 교단 명부에 이름을 씁니다.
success_text_en: Your friend smiles and signs the roll.
fail_text_en: 'You really have changed,' your friend says, leaving.

label: 가장 탐욕스러운 후보를 지지한다
label_en: Endorse the greediest candidate
success_text_en: The elected mayor grants your cult favors.
fail_text: 지지한 후보가 낙선해 새 시장의 눈 밖에 납니다.
fail_text_en: Your candidate loses and the new mayor holds a grudge.

label: 직접 출마를 선언한다
label_en: Announce your own candidacy
success_text: 깜짝 당선으로 시청이 교단의 손에 들어옵니다.
success_text_en: A surprise win puts city hall in your cult's hands.
fail_text_en: You lose badly and waste the campaign funds.

label: 중립을 지킨다
label_en: Stay neutral
success_text_en: No candidate bothers with you.

label: 교단 장부를 교묘히 꾸민다
label_en: Cleverly cook the cult's books
success_text_en: Tax officers praise you as a 'model tax evader.'
fail_text: 너무 서툴러 오히려 정직하다고 판정받고 가산세를 맞습니다.
fail_text_en: It's so clumsy you're judged honest and hit with the surcharge.

label: 정직하게 신고하고 가산세를 낸다
label_en: File honestly and pay the surcharge
success_text_en: You lost money, but your conscience is clear.

label: 신도들에게 세금 대신 헌금을 받는다
label_en: Collect offerings from followers instead of taxes
success_text_en: Followers gladly pay: 'Better than taxes.'
fail_text_en: Followers grumble that you're no better than the tax office.

label: 유쾌한 조롱 축사를 한다
label_en: Give a witty mocking speech
success_text_en: The crowd roars with laughter.

label: 신고자들을 변호한다
label_en: Defend the whistleblowers
success_text: 일부 시민은 당신의 용기에 감동하지만, 대다수는 혀를 찹니다.
success_text_en: A few citizens are moved by your courage, but most click their tongues.
fail_text_en: The police put you on a watch list.

label: 행사 후원금만 내고 빠진다
label_en: Donate to the event and skip it
success_text_en: Your cult's name hangs big on the banner.

label: 파업을 축복하고 함께 행진한다
label_en: Bless the strike and march with them
success_text_en: Dozens of workers join your cult.

label: 사장과 노동자 사이를 중재한다
label_en: Mediate between boss and workers
success_text_en: Both sides compromise thanks to you.
fail_text_en: Both sides curse you as a spineless mediator.

label: 사장에게 파업 정보를 판다
label_en: Sell strike intel to the boss
success_text_en: The boss hands you a fat reward.
fail_text_en: The betrayal leaks and workers surround your temple.

label: 신도 전원을 데려가 즐긴다
label_en: Bring every follower and enjoy
success_text: 김이 서린 탕 안에서 신도들이 한층 가까워집니다.
success_text_en: In the steamy baths, followers grow much closer.

label: 팻말을 떼라고 주인과 담판한다
label_en: Confront the owner to take the sign down
success_text_en: The owner grumbles and takes it down.
fail_text: 주인이 당신을 출입 금지 명단에 올립니다.
fail_text_en: The owner adds you to the banned list.

label: 목욕탕을 통째로 빌린다
label_en: Rent out the whole bathhouse
success_text_en: It becomes a grand night for the cult alone.
fail_text_en: The boiler breaks and only cold water runs.

label: '기다리는 자는 빼앗긴다'고 주장한다
label_en: Argue 'Those who wait get robbed'
success_text: 학생들이 당신의 말을 노트에 받아 적습니다.
success_text_en: Students write down your every word.

label: 인내의 가치를 역설한다
label_en: Champion the value of patience
success_text_en: A few earnest students seek out your cult.
fail_text_en: Boos ring out: 'A fossil of an idea!'

label: 교수들을 술자리로 매수한다
label_en: Win over the professors with drinks
success_text_en: The professors add your doctrine to their lecture notes.
fail_text: 만취해 기억도 안 나는 실언을 합니다.
fail_text_en: You get blackout drunk and say things you can't recall.

label: 공개적으로 꾸짖는다
label_en: Scold them publicly
success_text_en: Followers recommit to the doctrine.

label: 그 행동을 감싸준다
label_en: Defend what they did
success_text_en: Followers accept it: 'The leader has a deeper meaning.'
fail_text_en: Followers waver, sensing the doctrine is shaky.

label: 주인에게 사례금을 받아오라고 한다
label_en: Tell them to go collect a reward from the owner
success_text_en: The reward goes into the offering box.
fail_text_en: The owner sneers, 'I knew it.'

label: 코웃음 치고 지나간다
label_en: Scoff and walk on
success_text: 당신은 자신의 길에 더 확신을 갖습니다.
success_text_en: You grow more certain of your path.

label: 점쟁이 앞에 앉아 더 듣는다
label_en: Sit and hear more
success_text_en: An unexpected insight deepens your faith.
fail_text_en: You lose the fee and hear only nonsense.

label: 점쟁이를 교단 점술사로 고용한다
label_en: Hire them as the cult's diviner
success_text_en: Followers line up for readings.
fail_text_en: The fortune-teller vanishes with the advance.

label: 축복 빵 사업에 동참한다
label_en: Join the blessed-bread business
success_text_en: The bread sells out every morning.

label: 가난한 이들에게 빵을 나눈다
label_en: Hand out bread to the poor
success_text_en: Hungry neighbors remember you.
fail_text_en: You're mocked as 'the cult of bread beggars.'

label: 가격을 다섯 배로 올리자고 한다
label_en: Push the price up fivefold
success_text_en: Proof that the pricier it is, the better it sells.
fail_text_en: No one buys and the bread rots.

label: 쿠폰을 홍보물로 뿌린다
label_en: Hand out the coupons as recruitment flyers
success_text: 고기 냄새에 이끌린 사람들이 교단에 기웃거립니다.
success_text_en: Drawn by the smell of meat, people drift toward your cult.

label: 가게와 독점 계약을 맺는다
label_en: Sign an exclusive deal with the shop
success_text_en: A cut of the shop's revenue comes to you.
fail_text_en: The shop goes bust in a month.

label: 절식 캠페인으로 대항한다
label_en: Counter with a fasting campaign
success_text: 몇몇 지친 이들이 오히려 위안을 얻습니다.
success_text_en: A few weary people find comfort in it.
fail_text_en: You're called 'the mad cult that fasts in front of meat.'

label: 금박 왕관 머리를 한다
label_en: Get a gold-leaf crown hairdo
success_text_en: Your photos plaster the neighborhood boards.

label: 평범한 머리로 나간다
label_en: Go with a plain cut
success_text_en: It earns a small fanbase as 'rebel fashion.'
fail_text_en: The audience yawns and leaves.

label: 신도들 모두 같은 머리를 하게 한다
label_en: Make all followers wear the same style
success_text_en: The cult hairstyle becomes a street trend.
fail_text_en: Followers complain about the salon bills.

label: 경찰서장과 담판을 짓는다
label_en: Negotiate directly with the police chief
success_text_en: The chief exempts cult vehicles from checks.
fail_text_en: The chief cracks down on you even harder.

label: 벌금을 대신 내준다
label_en: Pay the fine on their behalf
success_text_en: The follower is moved and swears loyalty.

label: 과속을 교리로 장려한다
label_en: Promote speeding as doctrine
success_text_en: Cult cars become a local spectacle.
fail_text_en: A follower crashes and criticism pours in.

label: 유쾌한 추천사를 쓴다
label_en: Write a cheerful blurb
success_text_en: Your cult's crest appears on the cover.

label: 속편으로 교리 그림책을 직접 쓴다
label_en: Write a doctrinal sequel yourself
success_text_en: Children recite your doctrine like nursery rhymes.
fail_text_en: The art is too scary and returns flood in.

label: 반대로 정직한 결말로 고쳐 달라고 한다
label_en: Ask them to change it to an honest ending
success_text: 사서가 몰래 당신의 결말판을 꽂아 둡니다.
success_text_en: The librarian secretly shelves your version.
fail_text_en: The library classifies you as a dangerous person.

label: 교주로서 큰 몫을 보탠다
label_en: Add a big share as the leader
success_text: 당첨! 교단 전체가 밤새 춤을 춥니다.
success_text_en: A win! The whole cult dances all night.
fail_text_en: Nothing, but you all laugh it off together.

label: 기금으로 단체 잔치를 하자고 한다
label_en: Suggest spending the pool on a feast
success_text_en: Everyone is happy with the sure pleasure.

label: 기금을 고아원에 기부하자고 한다
label_en: Suggest donating the pool to an orphanage
success_text_en: A few followers feel a strange pride.
fail_text_en: They protest: 'Playing saint with our money!'

label: 아이에게 욕망 일기 쓰는 법을 가르친다
label_en: Teach the child to write a desire diary
success_text: 다음 숙제에서 만점을 받아 부모가 감격합니다.
success_text_en: The child aces the next one and the parent is overjoyed.

label: 학교에 항의하러 간다
label_en: Go protest at the school
success_text_en: The teacher corrects the grade.
fail_text_en: The teacher sneers, 'No wonder, with parents like that.'

label: 아이에게 참은 것도 용기라고 말해준다
label_en: Tell the child holding back is courage too
success_text_en: The child smiles shyly.
fail_text_en: The parent worries you're spoiling the child.

label: 거울 속 자신을 외면한다
label_en: Look away from your reflection
success_text_en: Swallowing unease, you straighten your gaudy collar.

label: 거울 속 자신에게 말을 건다
label_en: Speak to your reflection
success_text_en: The mirror stills and an old faith awakens.
fail_text_en: The silent mirror chills you.

label: 거울을 깨뜨린다
label_en: Smash the mirror
success_text: 깨진 조각마다 확신에 찬 당신이 비칩니다.
success_text_en: Every shard reflects a confident you.
fail_text_en: You cut your hand badly on the glass.

label: 그를 교단으로 받아들인다
label_en: Welcome them into the cult
success_text_en: The lonely neighbor becomes a devoted follower.
fail_text_en: The neighborhood starts shunning the cult too.

label: 따돌림에 동참해 인기를 얻는다
label_en: Join the shunning to gain popularity
success_text_en: The locals see you as 'one of us.'

label: 그에게 기부를 교단 헌금으로 돌리라고 한다
label_en: Tell them to redirect donations to the cult
success_text: 기부 대신 헌금이 되니 소문도 잠잠해집니다.
success_text_en: Donations become offerings and the rumor dies down.
fail_text_en: The neighbor shuts the door: 'It's all about money.'

label: 유머러스하게 망신을 진행한다
label_en: Run the shaming with humor
success_text_en: The guests double over with laughter.

label: 그 하객을 감싸준다
label_en: Shield that guest
success_text_en: The guest thanks you and quietly visits your cult later.
fail_text: 신랑 측이 '분위기 파악 못 한다'며 화냅니다.
fail_text_en: The groom's side fumes that you can't read the room.

label: 가장 많이 낸 하객에게 축복을 판다
label_en: Sell a blessing to the biggest giver
success_text_en: The big spender gladly pays.
fail_text_en: The bride cries that you turned her wedding into a market.

label: 자릿세를 받고 허락한다
label_en: Accept the rent and allow it
success_text_en: Crowds bustle before and after services.

label: 자릿세를 두 배로 부른다
label_en: Demand double rent
success_text_en: The vendors grit their teeth and pay.
fail_text_en: The vendors leave for the next neighborhood.

label: 무료로 자리를 내준다
label_en: Give them the space for free
success_text_en: The vendors guard your temple like followers.

label: 욕망 설교로 죄수들을 사로잡는다
label_en: Captivate inmates with a sermon on desire
success_text: 죄수들이 출소 후 교단을 찾겠다고 약속합니다.
success_text_en: Inmates promise to join after release.

label: 모범수 제도에 항의한다
label_en: Protest the model-prisoner system
success_text_en: The warden reluctantly revises the system.
fail_text_en: The warden bans you permanently.

label: 소장과 교도소 매점 이권을 나눈다
label_en: Split the prison commissary profits with the warden
success_text_en: Commissary profits flow into your coffers.
fail_text_en: An audit hits and the warden sells you out.

label: 수행으로 채택한다
label_en: Adopt it as a practice
success_text_en: Followers merrily critique one another's lies.

label: '하루 한 번 진실 말하기'로 바꾼다
label_en: Change it to 'Tell one truth a day'
success_text: 의외로 신도들이 진실 고백에 해방감을 느낍니다.
success_text_en: Surprisingly, followers find confession liberating.
fail_text_en: Followers protest that you're reversing the doctrine.

label: 거짓말 대회로 키워 상금을 건다
label_en: Turn it into a lying contest with prizes
success_text_en: The contest becomes a signature cult event.
fail_text_en: Lies spiral into real quarrels.

label: 가장 많이 챙긴 자를 칭찬한다
label_en: Praise whoever grabbed the most
success_text_en: Competition flares, but people grow distant.

label: 수확을 공평하게 나눈다
label_en: Divide the harvest fairly
success_text_en: Everyone smiles holding equal baskets.
fail_text_en: Some leave: 'Fairness is a loser's logic.'

label: 수확물로 단체 바비큐를 연다
label_en: Throw a group barbecue with the harvest
success_text_en: With full bellies, the fight is forgotten.
fail_text_en: Underripe vegetables upset everyone's stomach.

label: 마음껏 쓰고 즐기라고 한다
label_en: Tell them to spend and enjoy freely
success_text: 노인이 크루즈 여행 전단을 들고 웃습니다.
success_text_en: The elder smiles, holding a cruise brochure.

label: 아낀 삶도 의미 있었다고 위로한다
label_en: Comfort them that a frugal life had meaning
success_text_en: The elder lets go of a long-held regret.
fail_text_en: The elder grows bitter: 'I don't need comfort.'

label: 재산을 교단에 맡기라고 권한다
label_en: Urge them to entrust their savings to the cult
success_text_en: The elder hands over their bankbook.
fail_text_en: The children arrive threatening to sue.

label: 밤새 욕망에 대해 명상한다
label_en: Meditate on desire all night
success_text_en: By dawn, your conviction has hardened.
fail_text_en: The more you think, the emptier you feel.

label: 쪽지를 설교 주제로 쓴다
label_en: Use the note as a sermon topic
success_text_en: Followers listen intently.

label: 쪽지 쓴 사람을 찾아낸다
label_en: Track down the writer
success_text_en: The writer turns out to be your very first follower.
fail_text_en: Suspicion spreads among the followers.

label: 합동 행사를 연다
label_en: Hold the joint event
success_text: 땀 흘린 회원들이 교단 명부에 이름을 올립니다.
success_text_en: Sweaty members sign your roster.

label: 헬스장 회원권을 헌금 혜택으로 묶는다
label_en: Bundle gym memberships as an offering perk
success_text_en: Word spreads: donate and the gym is free.
fail_text_en: The gym owner pockets all the profit.

label: 인내의 운동법을 가르친다
label_en: Teach a patience-based workout
success_text: 꾸준한 회원 몇이 당신을 스승으로 모십니다.
success_text_en: A few steady members take you as their mentor.
fail_text_en: Members leave, calling it a sluggish workout.

label: 싸게 사서 성물로 비싸게 판다
label_en: Buy it cheap and resell it as a relic
success_text_en: The seal sells high as a 'cautionary relic.'
fail_text_en: Nobody cares and it gathers dust in storage.

label: 도장을 사서 소중히 간직한다
label_en: Buy it and cherish it
success_text_en: Each glance at the seal steadies your heart.

label: 가게 주인과 위조 성물 사업을 한다
label_en: Start a fake relic business with the dealer
success_text_en: The fakes sell like hotcakes.
fail_text_en: An appraiser exposes you and you're disgraced.

label: 일부러 호화 파티를 열어 이미지를 바꾼다
label_en: Throw a lavish party on purpose to change your image
success_text: 설문 순위가 쭉 떨어지고 인기는 오릅니다.
success_text_en: Your ranking plummets and your popularity soars.

label: 1위를 담담히 받아들인다
label_en: Accept first place calmly
success_text: 조롱 섞인 기사가 나오지만 마음은 평온합니다.
success_text_en: A mocking article runs, but your heart is calm.

label: 경쟁자를 조작해 1위로 올린다
label_en: Rig the poll to push a rival to first
success_text_en: Your rival becomes a laughingstock as 'Temperance King.'
fail_text_en: The rigging is exposed on the front page.

label: 시상을 맡아 권위를 높인다
label_en: Present the award and raise your standing
success_text_en: You forge a close bond with the fire department.

label: 빨리 끈 소방관을 따로 칭찬한다
label_en: Separately praise the firefighter who acted fast
success_text_en: That firefighter becomes the cult's guardian.
fail_text_en: The fire chief throws you out of the ceremony.

label: 교단 건물 화재 보험료를 깎아 달라고 한다
label_en: Ask for a discount on your temple's fire insurance
success_text_en: The chief smiles and amends the paperwork.
fail_text_en: Calling you shameless, the chief tightens inspections.

label: 합본을 승낙한다
label_en: Agree to the combined edition
success_text_en: Your scripture sits in every kitchen.

label: 교리 요리 강좌를 연다
label_en: Run doctrinal cooking classes
success_text_en: Followers memorize doctrine while cooking.
fail_text_en: You waste money on ingredients and no one comes.

label: '적게 먹는 법' 장을 넣자고 한다
label_en: Ask to add a chapter on eating less
success_text: 요리사가 마지못해 짧은 장을 넣어 줍니다.
success_text_en: The chef reluctantly adds a short chapter.
fail_text_en: The chef calls it blasphemy and tears up the deal.

label: 교주가 먼저 털어놓는다
label_en: Confess first as the leader
success_text_en: Your candor makes followers open up.
fail_text_en: You're so frank that followers are flustered.

label: 조용히 들어주기만 한다
label_en: Just listen quietly
success_text_en: Followers lay down their burdens before you.

label: 털어놓은 비밀을 장부에 적어둔다
label_en: Note the confessed secrets in a ledger
success_text_en: Followers obey you with more fear.
fail_text_en: The ledger is found and followers are enraged.

label: 공개 연회에서 진탕 먹고 마신다
label_en: Feast and drink lavishly at a public banquet
success_text_en: The rumor vanishes instantly.

label: '그렇다'고 인정한다
label_en: Admit 'It's true'
success_text_en: Followers are awed by your hidden depth.
fail_text_en: Followers stir with a sense of betrayal.

label: 소문 퍼뜨린 자를 찾는다
label_en: Find the rumor-monger
success_text_en: The gossip apologizes with an offering.
fail_text_en: You suspect the wrong follower and the mood sours.

label: 더 큰 현수막으로 맞선다
label_en: Answer with a bigger banner
success_text_en: The street becomes famous for the banner war.

label: 경쟁 교단과 연합을 제안한다
label_en: Propose an alliance with the rival
success_text_en: The two cults join hands and dominate the street.
fail_text: 경쟁 교단이 당신 제안을 조롱거리로 씁니다.
fail_text_en: The rival uses your offer as a joke.

label: 무시하고 조용히 지낸다
label_en: Ignore it and keep quiet
success_text_en: People whisper that you're scared.

label: 교단 자금을 몽땅 넣는다
label_en: Put all the cult's funds in
success_text_en: It hits big and your coffers overflow.
fail_text_en: The product crashes and your coffers empty.

label: 일부만 조심스럽게 넣는다
label_en: Invest only a cautious portion
success_text_en: Modest gains pile up.
fail_text_en: You lose a little and the teller calls you a coward.

label: 예금을 고집한다
label_en: Insist on a plain deposit
success_text_en: The teller sighs right in your face.

label: 가장 큰 야망을 적는다
label_en: Write down your greatest ambition
success_text: 불길 속으로 소원이 솟아오르며 가슴이 뜁니다.
success_text_en: Your wish rises into the flames and your heart races.

label: '흔들리지 않는 마음'이라 적는다
label_en: Write 'An unwavering heart'
success_text_en: Others snicker, but your heart is still.
fail_text: 소원지를 본 이웃이 크게 소리 내어 읽으며 놀립니다.
fail_text_en: A neighbor reads it aloud and mocks you.

label: 신도들의 소원지를 대신 써준다
label_en: Write wish slips for your followers
success_text_en: Followers keep your handwriting like charms.
fail_text: 글씨를 못 알아봐 소원이 엉망이 됩니다.
fail_text_en: Your handwriting is illegible and the wishes are garbled.
